evidence:
METHOD. Read instruction.md and both /instructions notes in full; no spell-check library or system word list was available, so spelling was checked by extracting and reading the complete unique-word list of each file (395 / 1102 / 115 words) plus the full read-through. Greps and scripted scans ran over the three files. The private deterministic checkers check-instruction-content.py and check-instruction-hygiene.py were NOT executed (not available to this reviewer); their documented behaviour was applied by hand only.

CLEAN ON THE ROW'S MAIN TESTS. (1) Spelling: no misspelled word found in any of the three files. Compounds such as nonnegative, nonfinite, nonblank, committable, revalidating, contra are deliberate. (2) Draft markers: case-insensitive grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem returned no hit; the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' stub is fully replaced. (3) Other machines' paths / authoring residue: grep for drive letters, /home/, /Users/, /mnt/, .qc-cache, turing-workspace, judge, rubric, criteri, reviewer, QC, golden, oracle, {{, [[ returned no hit; every path named is a task path (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /app/node_modules) and both named note files exist under environment/instructions and are COPYed by environment/Dockerfile. (4) Duplicates: no repeated sentence over 40 characters and no doubled word in any file; no CRLF, tabs or trailing whitespace. (5) The contradiction classes the skill names are consistent: one clock value (hireops_rules.md:59-60 '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z' = seed reference_moment); one account list (instruction.md:19 seven emails = seed users exactly, roles and Band I/II/III = authority_tier 1/2/3); one password 'Hireops!2026' (instruction.md:19, hireops_rules.md:25 and :361); one seed path /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:15, integration.md:7); port 3000, /app/server.js, /app/app.db and DB_PATH agree between instruction.md:15 and integration.md:5-8; 15 seconds agrees (instruction.md:9, hireops_rules.md:521); two-to-four members agrees (instruction.md:7, hireops_rules.md:426, :507); vesting tables agree with seed constants (40%+12x5%=100% at 24 months; 20%+20x4%=100% at 32 months); section cross-references (1-12) all resolve, including 'its section 12' in instruction.md:13; seed holds exactly one DRAFT offer as hireops_rules.md:216 says.

RESIDUAL WORDING TENSIONS (why Note, not a clean Pass). None is a typo or pasted-in residue, but they are internal inconsistencies of the kind this row asks about:
(a) hireops_rules.md:80-81 states a universal: 'Every boundary in the system is half-open `[start, end)`: reaching the edge counts as having crossed it.' hireops_rules.md:241-242 states for revisions 'Equality fits', :448-449 requires final headroom only 'nonnegative', and :171-173 says an approval's run-rate 'must fit inside the requisition's remaining headroom' without saying what happens at exact equality. Read literally, the universal sentence and 'Equality fits' disagree, and approval at exact equality is left to inference. This matters because it is graded: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:434 (hro_approval_budget) requires 'remaining $.01 permits base$.01 ... distinguishes ... equality from strict-less-than', and the reference accepts equality (solution/app/src/index.js:315 'if (rate > available) reject'). The intended reading (budget equality fits everywhere) is the more natural one and is supported by 'overrun' and by the brief's 'both requisitions are fully committed' scenario, so I do not rate this a Fail; that criterion is 0.36170212 of a 64.404 weight sum, about 0.56% of the functional dimension.
(b) hireops_rules.md:403 'Approving mints three things and we need to see all of them' versus :12-13 and :220-228, which list four things minted on approval (budget commitment, equity grant, referral accrual, signing remittance). Explicable (the commitment is covered by the preceding paragraph on movements) but the counts differ on their face.
(c) hireops_rules.md:37-39 'the auditor changes nothing at all. Provide requisition creation for the Recruiter. Other signed-in roles may also open requisitions' - the auditor is a signed-in role, so the optional permission literally overlaps the absolute statement. Optional and uncommitted money, so low impact.
(d) hireops_rules.md:118 'Four years is this grant's full vesting term for the purpose of annualizing its value' versus :329 full vesting at 32 completed months. Hedged by 'for the purpose of annualizing' and fixed by the constant, but two 'full vesting' durations appear.
(e) hireops_rules.md:303-304 'referring an employee also requires that hire's separate start date' is garbled relative to :209-211 (the offer names a referring employee and the referred hire's start date); meaning is recoverable.
(f) Spelling variants are mixed, not wrong: instruction.md uses 'honour/honouring/behaviour', integration.md:7 'honoring', hireops_rules.md:420 'Honor' alongside 'labelled' (:428) and 'cancelled' (:274). Several lines in hireops_rules.md (38, 84, 303, 410, 548) run past the file's wrap width, visible signs of later insertion but not content defects.

WHAT IS GOOD. The brief and notes are free of grader vocabulary, placeholders, foreign paths and duplicated blocks, and every runtime fact that appears twice agrees.

RISK. risk=true for two reasons: item (a) is an unresolved wording inconsistency that touches one graded bar and should be reconciled by the owner with the ambiguity/coverage rows (6, 27) rather than waived here; and the deterministic instruction checkers were applied by hand, not run. No runtime, Oracle, model or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: Not a Fail, so none is required; for reconciliation: an app that applies hireops_rules.md:80-81 literally to the approval budget gate (refusing an approval whose run-rate exactly equals remaining headroom, while honouring the explicit 'Equality fits' for revisions and nonnegative final headroom for change sets) would lose hro_approval_budget although it follows a sentence of the public rules.
suggested_fix: Optional, task-specific text only: in hireops_rules.md section 3 or 4 state that a run-rate exactly equal to remaining headroom fits (as section 5 already says for revisions), or scope line 80-81 to bands, vesting and cliff boundaries; change 'mints three things' at line 403 to wording that does not contradict the four listed in section 5; reword line 303-304 to 'an offer naming a referring employee also requires the referred hire's separate start date'. Any such edit creates a new candidate and invalidates this clearance.
